// DX icon names → Lucide icons (https://lucide.dev, ISC licence). Same grammar as the Figma Icons page:
// 24×24 grid, 2px round stroke, currentColor.
// Names stay stable across releases; add the Lucide icons your project needs here (this file is yours once installed).
import {
  ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, Bell, Bookmark, Calendar, ChartColumn, Check, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight, ChevronsUpDown, ChevronUp, CircleAlert, CircleCheck, CircleHelp, CirclePlus, CircleX, Clock, Copy,
  CreditCard, Download, Ellipsis, ExternalLink, Eye, EyeOff, File, Folder, Globe, GripVertical, Heart, House, Image,
  Info, LayoutDashboard, LayoutGrid, Link, List, ListFilter, Lock, LogIn, LogOut, Mail, MapPin, Menu, Minus, Moon,
  Paperclip, Pencil, Phone, Plus, Printer, Redo2, RefreshCw, Save, Search, Send, Settings, Share2, ShoppingCart, Star,
  Sun, Trash2, TriangleAlert, Undo2, Upload, User, X, type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

export const iconNames = Object.keys(iconMap) as IconName[];
